item.title: M8 MLBB: Where Worlds Will Be Held and How Teams Can Reach Istanbul
item.description: Istanbul hosts the M8 Main Stage and Bangkok hosts Wild Card. MCT SEA already has a detailed route; MCC and other regional quotas are still pending.
item.dc:creator: Boost MLBB Editorial Team
item.yandex:full-text:
The 30-second answer
The Main Stage M8 will be in Istanbul, Türkiye, while the Wild Card will be in Bangkok, Thailand. Exact M8 match dates have not been announced.
The first fully published M8 route is MCT SEA: groups run on December 9–10 and playoffs on December 11–13, 2026.
MCT SEA's Top-2 qualify directly for Main Stage; place 3 and place 4 go to Wild Card, where three teams reach Main Stage.
Exact quotas and schedules for MCT EECA, including the MCC route, plus MCT AMER and EMEA have not yet been released.
The short answer is that M8 World Championship will bring the M Series' main stage to Europe for the first time, in Istanbul, Türkiye, while its Wild Card stage will be in Bangkok, Thailand. As of August 21, 2026, MOONTON Games has published a detailed MCT Southeast Asia route, named the next East Asia tournament in Ulaanbaatar, and confirmed that MCT EECA, EMEA, and Americas qualification phases will be announced later. This is therefore a map of what teams and fans can plan around now—not a guess at future slots.
Where M8 will be held and what we know about dates

It is important not to merge two calendars. Qualifiers take place in the second half of 2026, while M8 itself belongs to early 2027. December MCT SEA dates are qualification dates, not Istanbul match dates. For fans in Russia and across EECA, the sensible next step is to follow specific MCT announcements: without a published start time, converting a future match into Moscow time would be invented information.
The clearest route: MCT SEA in December
MCT SEA brings together 12 teams from 11 sovereign Southeast Asian countries. It does not replace every domestic league; it is a cross-regional bridge for strong non-franchised rosters. Entry points include MSL Myanmar, MPL Cambodia, MPL Singapore, and local qualifiers in Vietnam, Timor-Leste, Brunei, and Laos. Thailand receives two berths: its regular berth plus a host-country berth for the first MCT SEA. The MDL Philippines, MDL Indonesia, and MAL Malaysia champions make up a separate Open League Qualifier Group and play for one playoff berth.
MCT SEA — schedule and what each finish earns
Three teams advance from Wild Card to Main Stage. This is a confirmed MCT SEA route rule, not a universal quota for every region.
2026 date

Group Stage
The top two from Groups A, B, and C reach playoffs; third places get a Last Chance Qualifier opportunity.

Last Chance Qualifier
One BO1 match for the final playoff spot among the third-place teams from Groups A, B, and C.
December 11–13
Knockout Playoffs
Places 1–2: direct Main Stage M8 in Istanbul; places 3–4: Wild Card M8 in Bangkok.
MCT SEA shows M8's new logic: a place comes through a defined route, not simply a region label. Open and developing leagues gain a real route to the world stage through dedicated qualification, not only through an MPL.
Why this matters beyond one league
East Asia, Americas, EECA, and EMEA: what is confirmed and what awaits
Regional-route status as of August 21, 2026
“Not published” means no confirmation was found in the current official source set; it does not mean no future qualifier will exist.

East Asia (China, Mongolia, Japan, Korea)
The next MCT EA x ESN will be in Ulaanbaatar on October 31; MOONTON calls it a route toward M8 qualification.
Detailed participants, format, and quotas are still unpublished.
Americas (North, Central, and Latin America, Brazil)
MCT AMER is part of the five-region structure and is due to continue the M8 cycle later.
No published dates, bracket, or number of places.
EECA / MCC (Eastern Europe and Central Asia)
MCT EECA is explicitly named among the next qualification phases; Team Spirit's MSC win strengthened the region's profile.
No confirmed rule says three MCC teams receive M8 berths.
EMEA (Europe, Middle East, and Africa)
MCT EMEA is part of the same next set of M8 qualification circuits.
No published dates, slots, or selection format.
Franchised MPL and partner leagues
They operate alongside MCT within the global MLBB Esports system.
Their specific M8 routes and allocation must await organizer regulations.
What this means for Russia, EECA, and MCC
Russia and neighboring countries are part of the EECA story that matters to this article's readers, but hope must not be presented as fact. Team Spirit's historic MSC 2026 win gives the region a powerful international marker: MOONTON describes the team as the first champion from outside Southeast Asia to win an official international MLBB major. That win does not publish M8 regulations automatically, however. The primary sources checked for this article do not confirm a formula under which three MCC teams receive M8 places. Until MOONTON releases MCT EECA or MCC rules, the accurate position is simple: there will be a route, but its number of slots, stages, and selection method are unknown.
Look for four things: the tournament name, date, Main Stage and Wild Card slot counts, and the rule for passing down a slot after repeat qualification. Without all four, a report of an “M8 berth” is incomplete.
How to read the next announcement
What to watch next
MCT EA x ESN in Ulaanbaatar on October 31: the organizer has promised separate participant, format, and qualification details.
Official MCT EECA, MCT EMEA, and MCT AMER announcements: those will set the regional M8 dates and quotas.
The full M8 rules: Bangkok and Istanbul dates, participant list, Wild Card and Main Stage format, and prize pool.
MCT SEA results on December 11–13: they will name the first two Main Stage teams and two Wild Card teams from this route.
This article deliberately separates confirmed routes from expectations. Once an official MCC/EECA or another regional regulation appears, it should be added to this same page without changing the URL. That lets readers see a transparent M8 update history rather than a new article with contradictory numbers.
